content: Tuta mwauna ꞌabwa ꞌilatuma
Coinega Yesu Hada Heꞌasisi saugaina ma ꞌiꞌebesine ma ꞌana tomuliyao sinaoma ta Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌana hadao Yesu ꞌoina siheꞌiteya.
Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Hadaedi mabwaiyadi waꞌebubudi, yagwae bwaibwaina ꞌabwa mabwaiyadi sileꞌwa yahuledi ma sahena wete tupwa ꞌiꞌiuna waꞌitaꞌita hila.”

Muliyetega ꞌitauya Olibe ꞌoyana ꞌoina ta ꞌimiyatoiya, ma ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌoina sinaoma ta siboidimo simiyamiya ma ꞌoinega sihesilaleya, sigwaeya, “Bada, ꞌuhegwaemai to tuta ꞌoina Hada Heꞌasisi sileꞌwa, ma ꞌino tuta hilama, ma tuta ꞌana ꞌebelosaloha weyahina ꞌadi ꞌilaꞌilala ꞌuheꞌitemai ma ꞌasanapu.”
Coinega Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Waꞌitayahigemi ꞌamuge ma tomota tupwadi siꞌabowegomi.
Weyahina ꞌabwa baibaiwadi saniguwega sihepwaila ma ꞌabehega sihanugete puigomi ma ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌigwae, ‘Taugu Toꞌabiheteina,’ ma tomota baibaiwadi simuliyedi.
Wete wasa ꞌabwa wahesagohedi ꞌalehao deimiya ma bwaga weyahidi, ma sahena waꞌateꞌateyoho. Weyahina ginaula bewa silatu nugeta ma hesi baleꞌu ꞌana ꞌebelosaloha ꞌabwa.
Weyahina ꞌabwa hali boda ma hali boda ꞌoidiya siloꞌaleha, ma wete hali ꞌebeloina ma hali ꞌebeloina ꞌoidiyega siloꞌaleha, ma gomale madouna ma mwaniꞌiniꞌi silatu tupwa mabwaiyadi ꞌoidiya.
Ma ginaulaedi tuta mwaudi ꞌadi ꞌebehegaina tuwa.
“Comi nata tomota siꞌabiyahigomi ma siꞌabihe muyemuyegomi nuwana siloheꞌamasigomi, ma tupwa mabwaiyadi tomotainao siloꞌalehegomi weyahina ꞌabehega ꞌomi ꞌagu tohemisao,
ma mwauwedi weyahidi ꞌabwa tupwami waweꞌa ma waboimo ꞌiyamiyao watebaedi, nuwana waloꞌalehedi.
Wete palopita ꞌaboꞌabowao silatuma ma tupwami sihanugete puigomi.
Ma wete mumuga galana ꞌina madou ꞌoinega tomota tupwana baibaiwana ꞌidi helau ꞌatediyega ꞌiweꞌa.
Ma ꞌeguma taiya ꞌiheꞌalamaꞌiꞌita ma ꞌitoholo paꞌala ma ꞌana siga tuta ꞌana ꞌebelosaloha ꞌoina, yaliyaya hataya ꞌiloba.
“Ma Yehoba ꞌina loina tetelina ꞌiꞌedadana nugeta tupwa mabwaiyana ꞌoidiya, ma boda mabwaiyadi ꞌana loguguya sihesagohe, ma muliyetega tuta ꞌana ꞌebelosaloha ꞌilatu.
Mwau madouna
“Cabwa ꞌilaꞌilalaina palopita Daniyela ꞌihepwaila nugetaeya ꞌilatu, beno ginaula gala hedade ma didiga tupwa heꞌasisi ꞌoina ꞌitoholo. (Ceguma taiya gwae bewa ꞌihasili ꞌinuwasabwalena.)
Tuta nage ꞌoina Yudiya ꞌana tomiyanao sawasawahidi ma ꞌoya ꞌoidiya sidena.
Ma ꞌeguma taiya wagahata ꞌimiyamiya ꞌidena mwayamwayau, ma sahena ꞌiluhuluhu hila ꞌina hada ꞌina tobwatobwa sabi ꞌewadi.
Ma ꞌeguma taiya tanoha ꞌipaipaihowa sahena ꞌihilahila ꞌana ꞌaleꞌo hali tupwa ꞌilaguya sabi ꞌewa.
“Ma tuta nage ꞌoina togamwagamwao ma tohesusuwao siheꞌatemuyamuya.
Coinega waꞌahwanoi ma tuta ꞌausalana Yehoba ꞌiꞌebwaegomi ꞌimi tuta dena ꞌoina, ma sahena gogai ꞌana tuta, bo nuwana Sabati ꞌoina.
“Moisa, tuta nage mwau hedade, weyahina baleꞌu ꞌana hemasalaha hohau ꞌoinega eeta ꞌana siga tuta bewa, geya ꞌaigeda wete mwauina bewa gide, ma muliyetega mwau bewa sahena wete ꞌilatulatu hilama.
Mwau nage ꞌana sabwelowao ꞌeguma Yehoba sahena ꞌiꞌabiꞌabi hetoꞌutoꞌupadi, nata tomota mabwaiyadi siꞌamasa, ma hesi Yehoba sabwelowedi ꞌiꞌabihe toꞌutoꞌupadi beno ꞌina boda heheꞌasaidi weyahidi.
“Coinega ꞌeguma taiya ꞌihegwaegomi ma ꞌigwae, ‘Keliso bewa,’ nuwana ‘Nage,’ sahena wahehemisedi.

Weyahina Keliso ꞌaboꞌabodi ma palopita ꞌaboꞌabodi ꞌabwa silatu ma ꞌilaꞌilala waiwaidi tomota matadiya sipaihowaidi, ma ꞌoidiyega ꞌeguma sawasawahidi Yehoba ꞌina bodao heheꞌasaidi wete sida ꞌabiheꞌwanidi.
Ma ꞌomi ginaula bewa weyahina yahepwaila nugeta pwaiya ꞌoimiya.
“Coinega ꞌeguma sihegwaegomi, sigwae, ‘Keliso tupwa balabala ꞌawawa ꞌimiyamiya,’ sahena pwatula nage ꞌoina watautauya. Ma ꞌeguma sigwae, ‘Keliso hada ꞌalona ꞌimiyamiya,’ sahena wahehemisedi.
“Taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌigu latu hilama ꞌana ꞌita gide tuwa namala madouna yalasiyega ꞌiꞌasilala ta ꞌana siga bwauli.
“Taꞌeha ꞌoina ꞌwayoha ꞌimiyamiya beno ꞌoina ꞌaoꞌao siꞌauꞌautama.
Yesu ꞌina hilama
“Ma tuta mwauina ꞌigumwala ma muliyetega sinala ꞌiguguyou, ma wete waiꞌena ꞌina ꞌasilala ꞌigibogibo, ma ꞌipwalao galewega sigubala, ma ginaula baibaiwadi galewa simiyamiya ꞌidi waiwai siweꞌa.
Tuta nage ꞌoina taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌigu ꞌilaꞌilala galewega ꞌilatuma, ma boda mabwaiyadi baleꞌuwa siꞌitegau yaloha pwatanega maꞌigu waiwai ma maꞌigu wasawasa madouna yalatulatuma, ma sidougwaegwae.
Ma wete yoguli simuꞌa ma ꞌigu aneloseyao yahesumanedi ma ꞌigu boda hesihesinuwaidi siheꞌautedima baleꞌu mabwaiyana ma yaumai mabwaiyana ꞌidi tupwa ꞌoidiyega.
Cebeꞌita saido ꞌoinega
“Cebeꞌita saido ꞌoinega yaheꞌitegomi, beno ꞌeguma saido ꞌigalugalu wasanapuya losihe ꞌana tuta deina.
Ma wete ꞌeguma ꞌilaꞌilalaedi bewa waꞌitaloba pwaidiya wasanasanapu ꞌabehega ꞌigu tuta hilama deina ꞌilatu pwaiya.
Moisa, yaso bewa nata geya wagumwala ma ꞌana siga ginaulaedi mabwaiyadi silatu.
Cabwa galewa ma baleꞌu sisawala, ma ꞌigu gwaeyao geyaꞌabwa tuwa sisawasawala.
Tuta nage geya ꞌaigeda ꞌisanapu
“Geya ꞌeta taiya ꞌisanapu to tuta, nuwana to sabwelo ꞌoina yahilama, ma wete aneloseyao galewa geya sisanapu. Taugu wete geya yasanapu. Tamagu ꞌiboinamo ꞌisanapuya.
Tuta nage, Nowa ꞌina tuta gide.
Weyahina Nowa ꞌina tuta tomota ꞌadi siꞌaiꞌai ma ꞌadi weꞌaha sinumanuma ma sihehehai, ma wete sihaihai, ma ꞌana siga Nowa ꞌina waga ꞌigeluwa,
ma yagewa ꞌiloheꞌateyohodiya, ta ꞌoinega tomota mabwaiyadi sidamana, ma taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌigu hilama gide.
“Tuta nage ꞌoina ꞌeguma loheya ꞌeluwa tanoha, ꞌaigeda yatoe ma ꞌaigeda ꞌimiyamiya.
Wete ꞌeguma wahiwahine siteluwa siꞌeꞌehalo, ꞌaigeda yatoe ma ꞌaigeda ꞌimiyamiya.
“Coinega waꞌitayahi bwaibwaini, weyahina ꞌigu hilama ꞌana tuta geya wasanapu.
Ma wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌeguma taiya hada toniwagana ꞌisanapuya ma to tuta nihuwana ꞌalona toyagaha ꞌiluhu ꞌina hada, ꞌiꞌatububu bwaibwaina ma ꞌiꞌoꞌoyatola, ma sahena ꞌina hada ꞌibwalebwale.
Coinega ꞌomi wete waꞌatububu bwaibwaina, ma ꞌigu tuta hila weyahina wayamwegau, weyahina taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌigu hilama ꞌana tuta geya wasanapu.
Topaihowao ꞌausaladi ma galadi
“Topaihowa ꞌausaladi ma sanasanapuidi ꞌidi mumuga bewa gide: Ceguma taiya tauna ꞌina bada ꞌihesinuweya ma hada ꞌiꞌitayahi ma topaihowao ꞌadi ꞌeꞌahai ꞌiꞌebwaedi sabwelo ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiya,
ꞌabwa ꞌeguma badaina ꞌihilama ma ꞌina topaihowaina ꞌiloba ꞌipaipaihowa dumwalu, nata weyahina ꞌiyaliyaya ma ꞌoina ꞌigwae,
‘Cino paihowa ꞌausaladi weyahina yayaliyaya, ꞌoinega ginaula mabwaiyadi ꞌadi loina yaꞌebwaego ma ꞌuloina.’
“Ma hesi ꞌeguma topaihowa ꞌimumuga galana ma ꞌiboinamo ꞌoina ꞌigwae, ‘Cigu bada ꞌabwa ꞌiheheboi,’
ma ꞌihegaina ma ꞌiyanao ꞌisapi dadanedi ma ꞌiꞌai hedahedade, nuwana ꞌinuma hedahedade toheyauyaule baꞌidanao,
ma ꞌoinega ꞌina bada ꞌeguma ꞌiloheꞌateyohoyama ma ꞌina paihowa galana ꞌiꞌitalobadi,
nata hadega ꞌipaꞌi ma maisa galana ꞌiꞌebwae toꞌabowao ꞌidi tupwa, nage ꞌoina sidou ma sihesalaꞌiꞌita, muya ꞌoinega”.
